question: Which module is the K-01 compressor located in?
Which physical ports belong to equipment K-01?
Which equipment receives fluid from compressor K-01?
sparql_gold:
PREFIX abox: <http://usp.ai/ontologies/fpeo-collect-equipments-abox#>
PREFIX core: <http://usp.ai/ontologies/fpeo-equipments-core#>
SELECT ?target WHERE {
  abox:VRUCompressor_K01 core:hasPort ?pOut .
  ?pOut core:portConnectedTo ?pIn .
  ?pIn core:isPortOf ?target .
}
